title: Deeper/broader LTYPE DXF text-field profile and retained-owner review
objective: Cross-check current open-source DWG/DXF peer safety signals, Autodesk DXF string rules, and local LTYPE parse/write/retained-memory paths; refine the existing implementation plan without creating a new feature finding.

sources.observation: The live index reports 95 open issues and lists #1450 (LTYPE group-9 dash-text heap-buffer-overflow), #1451 (FIELD zero-child use-after-free), and #1452 (misaligned BITCODE_RS in EED encoder) as open, opened 2026-10-14. Individual issue pages were not retrievable in this review.

The June 1, 2026 ChangeLog describes an earlier separate add_LTYPE_dashes overflow fix (GH #1209), including a static dash index persisting across calls and group-code-9 strings up to 4096 bytes overflowing fixed 256/512-byte DWG strings_area buffers. This is not evidence that newer #1450 is fixed or that libdxfrw has the same fixed-buffer route.
Group 9 is one text string per element only when group 74 identifies embedded text.

sources.role: Current generic DXF group-code string limits
sources.observation: The current table assigns strings in group-code range 1-4, 7, 9, and 300-309 a maximum of 255 characters, fewer for Unicode strings.

The older table documents an AutoCAD 2000 extended-symbol-name exception expanding the 0-9 string limit from 255 to 2049 single-byte characters. This conflicts with the current generic 255-character statement and requires version/profile qualification before enforcement.

observations: DRW_LType::parseCode assigns group 3 description and group 9 segment text directly through getUtf8String; code 9 is gated on an existing segment whose text flag is set.
dxfRW::writeLType emits group 9 with writeUtf8String; current LTYPE validateDxf does not define a code-9 field-length rule.

The table-entry shared retained lease covers its name and typed XDATA, but the derived DRW_LType description and segment text are not charged as long-lived model-owned retained strings. Current-record getter pre-admission and input-byte admission are distinct from this owner-lifetime charge.
DWG LTYPE string emission uses a separate version-specific fixed area and preflight already tracked under 7BF.2; it is not interchangeable with DXF group-9 field-length rules.
local_source_audit.tests_reviewed: The existing LTYPE mirror-authority test exercises path/segment authority but no dedicated raw ASCII/Binary group-9 field-length and next-table-row matrix was identified in the searched test sources.

plan_updates: Refine 7BF to distinguish DXF group-9 scope/target-version length from DWG's cumulative 256/512-byte string area; do not enforce a guessed global group-9 cap.
Add source-generated ASCII/Binary valid 74=2 text and malformed group-9-without-text-flag controls with following LTYPE-row sentinels to the existing owner.
Name 7S.2c.d.17.6 for aggregate retained-byte charging of LTYPE description and complex segment text, including reserve-before-replacement, copy/move/reset, exact-cap/one-under and retry behavior.
Keep existing 7K group-1004 boundary as the cheapest immediate independent implementation slice; keep DWG EED writer-size calibration separate.
limitations: The individual LibreDWG #1450-#1452 pages could not be retrieved in this pass; older plan text contains more specific observations that were not independently refreshed here.
